test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The meaning of _______ is freedom for economic decisions, which means that all the producers, owners and consumers of factors of production are free to take their decisions to promote their self - interest.
solution:
The correct answer is **economic liberalisation.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Economic Liberalisation:**

 
 
• Economic liberalisation refers to the process of reducing government interventions and restrictions in an economy.
 
• This allows for greater participation of private enterprises in economic activities, fostering competition, efficiency, and innovation.
 
• It includes the deregulation of industries, reduction of trade barriers, and the privatisation of state-owned enterprises, thereby providing producers, owners, and consumers the freedom to make economic decisions independently.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Privatisation:**

 
 
• Privatisation refers to the transfer of ownership of property or businesses from a government to a privately-owned entity.
 
 
• **Globalisation:**
 
 
• Globalisation is the process of interaction and integration among people, companies, and governments worldwide.
 
 
• **Corporatisation:**
 
 
• Corporatisation involves transforming state-owned enterprises into corporations or companies.
 
• It is a specific form of reform and does not necessarily imply the broader scope of economic freedom addressed by economic liberalisation.
